title: DrawRequest
description: What the merge card is drawn from: the slice, proof's answer, how the builder ended, the branch the work is on and how it got there, and the branch a merge goes into.

built.description: How the builder ended, as built.json gives it.

outcome.description: The slice is written in its worktree.

oneOf.description: The builder stopped, since the slice needs a capability that is not there.

outcome.description: The builder stopped before the slice was done.

missing.description: What is missing: where it would live, and its name. No sentence, so nothing a builder writes reaches a card.

lacks.description: Where the missing capability would live.

name.description: The name of the missing function, operation or action, such as worktrees.commit.

work.description: The branch the work is on: one set-aside committed it to, such as forge/wip/TR2/1, or one a round committed the tests to over the builder's work, such as forge/TR2-tests.

into.description: The branch a merge goes into, from forge's settings.

kept.description: How the work came to be on its branch: set aside by itself, or committed with the tests a test writer handed in. Left out, set aside.

rounds.description: Where the rounds stand after the last review, as rounds.json gives it. Left out, the card has no rounds.
